visual.general_description: Graphical abstract flow of intraoral scanning, Hotz-type plate fabrication and application 4-24 h after birth, with a Day 0 to Day 60 premaxillary alignment schematic.

A left-to-right flow: a cartoon newborn with an intraoral scanning wand near the mouth labelled "Newborn with BCLP"; an arrow to a laptop showing a pink-red 3D model of a cleft maxilla labelled "Intraoral Scanning"; an arrow to two drawn Hotz-type plate pieces labelled "Hotz-type Plate Fabrication"; an arrow carrying an hourglass icon and the text "4-24h after postpartum" to a second cartoon newborn labelled "Hotz-type Plate Applied". A bracket spans both newborns above the text "After only 2 months". A bordered box at the bottom, titled "Premaxillary Segment Alignment", shows two schematic upper-jaw drawings: "Day 0" with the premaxilla and two separate pink lateral segments, and an arrow to "Day 60" with the premaxilla joined to the lateral segments in an arch; "premaxilla" is printed beside each drawing. A footer at the lower left prints a BioRender credit naming an illustrator.
